0022600008.text: The Knicks (0-1) visit the Celtics (0-1) in their second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams still seeking their first win. Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. New York won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 112-106 victory in New York on April 9, 2026.
